findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Kostenlos lernen. Freiwillig unterstützen." → 3 lines (4 words, 66.2px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Geplant für nach der Beta" above "Kostenlos lernen. Freiwillig unterstütze"; "Kostenlos" above "0 € für immer"; "Jährlich" above "25 € im Jahr"; "Monatlich" above "2,99 € im Monat"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 4 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Geplant für nach der Beta", "Kostenlos", "Jährlich", "Monatlich").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 real photograph(s) or clip(s); the rest are interface fragments.
findings.fix: Add two or more real pictures of the customer's world from scripts/assets.mjs, not stock of people at laptops.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: The margins differ: 18px on the left, 42px on the right, at 768px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1844px at 10280px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: 1 display line(s) start inside the margin but run off the right edge by a few pixels: "Quidey" (23px)
findings.fix: Fit the line to the content box by measurement (a small fit script, or SVG text with textLength), or bleed it on purpose by a clear amount from the margin. A name sliced by a few pixels on one side reads as a mistake.
